title: Establish Secure Cloud Foundation & Database
description: As a System Administrator, I want a secure, isolated cloud environment with encrypted database storage so that user data is protected according to GDPR standards and the system allows no public access to sensitive data ports.
business_value: Ensures regulatory compliance (GDPR), protects user PII, and provides the scalable foundation required to launch the application.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Network Isolation Verification","given":"The cloud infrastructure stack has been deployed via CDK","when":"A network security audit is performed","then":"Database subnets must be completely isolated from the public internet and accessible only via the application VPC"},{"scenario":"Database Encryption Validation","given":"The Aurora Serverless v2 cluster is active","when":"Data persistence is attempted","then":"Data must be encrypted at rest using KMS keys and credentials must be retrieved securely from Secrets Manager"}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-INFRA-001: Define VPC and Network Topology (CDK)","WI-INFRA-002: Provision Aurora Serverless v2 PostgreSQL (CDK)","WI-INFRA-003: Setup OpenSearch Serverless for Vector Search (CDK)"]
definition_of_done: ["CDK stacks deployed successfully to Staging environment","Security group rules validated (Port 5432 closed to 0.0.0.0/0)","Secrets Manager rotation configured for database credentials"]

title: Secure User Authentication
description: As an App User, I want to securely log in and have my identity validated so that I can access my personalized library and ensure my reading data remains private.
business_value: Fundamental requirement for user data privacy and personalization; prevents unauthorized access to the system.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Successful Login","given":"The user provides valid credentials via the Auth0 interface","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"A valid JWT is issued, validated against the JWKS, and the user is granted access based on their role (Free/Premium)"},{"scenario":"Unauthenticated Request Block","given":"An anonymous user attempts to access the /library API endpoint","when":"The request reaches the API Gateway/Middleware","then":"The system must return a 401 Unauthorized response"}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-BE-001: Initialize .NET 8 Solution and Shared Kernel","WI-BE-002: Implement Auth0 JWT Authentication & Authorization"]
definition_of_done: ["Auth0 tenant configured",".NET Middleware intercepting and validating tokens","Integration tests passing for authorized vs unauthorized access"]

title: Manage Personal Book Library
description: As a Reader, I want to search for books and add them to my personal library so that I can organize my reading list and track what I want to read next.
business_value: Core value proposition of the app; enables users to utilize the application for its primary purpose.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Add Book via Search","given":"The user is on the 'Add Book' screen","when":"The user searches for a title (e.g., 'Dune')","then":"The system retrieves results from the Google Books API via the backend proxy and allows the user to save the book to their library"},{"scenario":"Free Tier Limit Enforcement","given":"A Free Tier user has 20 books in their library","when":"They attempt to add a 21st book","then":"The system must block the action and display a prompt to upgrade to Premium"},{"scenario":"External API Resilience","given":"The Google Books API is experiencing latency","when":"A search request is made","then":"The system applies a Circuit Breaker pattern (Polly) to fail gracefully without crashing the application"}]
definition_of_done: ["CRUD endpoints for LibraryItems implemented","Google Books API integration with Refit and Polly complete","Unit tests for Free Tier limit logic passing"]

title: View Reading Dashboard
description: As a Reader, I want to view a dashboard of my current reading status and goals immediately upon opening the app so that I can quickly resume my reading sessions.
business_value: High user engagement entry point; ensures the app feels responsive and useful immediately (Performance requirement < 1.5s load).
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Dashboard Load Performance","given":"The user opens the app (warm start)","when":"The dashboard initializes","then":"The UI must become fully interactive and display cached data within 1.5 seconds"},{"scenario":"Reactive Data Display","given":"The user has updated a goal","when":"They return to the dashboard","then":"The widgets must automatically reflect the new state via Riverpod providers without a manual refresh"}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-MOB-001: Initialize Flutter Project & Riverpod Setup","WI-MOB-003: Develop Dashboard UI & Widgets"]
definition_of_done: ["Dashboard UI matches Figma mockups","Riverpod providers configured for auto-dispose","Performance benchmarks met on target iOS/Android simulators"]

title: Offline Data Synchronization
description: As a Mobile User, I want my reading progress to be saved locally when I am offline and automatically synced to the cloud when I reconnect so that I never lose my data regardless of connectivity.
business_value: Critical reliability feature for mobile users; prevents data loss and ensures a seamless experience in low-connectivity environments.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Offline Write Persistence","given":"The device has no internet connection","when":"The user logs a reading session","then":"The data is persisted to the local Isar database and marked as 'pending sync'"},{"scenario":"Sync on Reconnect","given":"The user has pending offline changes","when":"Network connectivity is restored","then":"The background service automatically batches the changes and sends them to the backend API"},{"scenario":"Conflict Resolution","given":"The same record was modified on another device","when":"Synchronization occurs","then":"The system applies the 'Last Write Wins' strategy based on client timestamps"}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-MOB-002: Implement Isar Local Database Layer","WI-MOB-004: Implement Offline Synchronization Service","WI-BE-004: Develop Tracking & Sync Module"]
definition_of_done: ["Isar schema defined with sync flags","Background sync service functioning with connectivity_plus","Backend handles batch uploads and conflict resolution"]

title: Purchase Premium Subscription
description: As a Free User, I want to upgrade to a Premium subscription using my device's native payment system so that I can unlock unlimited books and advanced statistics.
business_value: Direct revenue generation; implements the core business model of the application.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Initiate Purchase","given":"A Free user is on the Subscription screen","when":"They tap 'Upgrade'","then":"The native iOS/Android purchase sheet is displayed with correct local pricing"},{"scenario":"Subscription Validation","given":"A purchase is completed successfully on the client","when":"The app store sends a webhook notification","then":"The backend validates the signature, updates the user's role to 'Premium' in the database, and the app UI updates immediately"},{"scenario":"Subscription Expiration","given":"A user's subscription expires","when":"The expiration webhook is received","then":"The backend reverts the user role to 'Free' and premium features are locked"}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-MON-001: Implement Backend Webhook Handler (Apple/Google)","WI-MON-002: Implement Mobile IAP UI & Logic"]
definition_of_done: ["IAP flow tested in Sandbox/TestFlight","Backend webhook signature verification active","Role-based access control (RBAC) tests passing for Premium features"]
